name: Real-time air traffic control tactical clearance
what_it_does: Autonomously evaluates aircraft positions, taxiways, and runway states to issue conflict-free takeoff, landing, and routing clearances in real-time.

name: Real-time interactive radio simulation
what_it_does: Simulates two-way ATC radio communications across Tower, Ground, Approach, and Departure controllers and aircraft pilots using distinct voice sessions.

name: Calibrated confidence scoring for action distribution
what_it_does: Outputs full probability spreads and calibrated confidence percentages across all alternative choices rather than naked categorical strings.

name: Sub-second multi-question structured text triage
what_it_does: Evaluates unstructured input against multiple classification types (choices, probabilities, and ordinal scales) in ~730ms without conversational latency.
